screening_decisions.reason: Observational cohort without randomisation and no direct comparison of surgical methods; does not meet RCT criterion.
Randomised controlled trial directly comparing manual vacuum aspiration (MVA) with conventional electric vacuum aspiration (VA) in first‑trimester abortions.
Population‑level trend analysis, not an RCT and does not compare surgical methods.
Randomised trial of prostaglandin cervical preparation versus placebo; both arms used vacuum aspiration, so no surgical method comparison.
Randomised trial comparing dilatation & curettage (D&C) with vacuum aspiration, fulfilling the surgical method comparison criterion.
Randomised trial directly comparing manual versus electric vacuum aspiration, meeting inclusion criteria.
Randomised assignment to MVA or EVA; compares two surgical techniques for first‑trimester abortion.
Study not identified as randomised; appears observational, thus does not meet RCT requirement.
Randomised allocation of different cannula types within vacuum aspiration; qualifies as RCT of surgical technique variations.
Randomised trial comparing manual vacuum aspirator with electric vacuum curettage devices, satisfying RCT surgical method comparison.
